status_summary: The Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026 (Public Law 119-75), enacted 2026-02-03, includes a narrower related step: per law-firm and think-tank summaries, section 6225 conditions Medicare payment for off-campus hospital outpatient departments on a separate provider identifier and an attestation from 2028-01-01, and CMS proposed implementing rules in its CY 2027 outpatient payment proposal published 2026-07-07. No bill was found that would repeal the Medicare Shared Savings Program, and CMS proposed on 2026-07-16 to revise and continue it in the CY 2027 physician fee schedule rule. The price transparency and value-based payment parts have executive-branch activity (see c14-16 and c14-21) but no codifying law was found.

timeline.event: The Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026 (Public Law 119-75, H.R. 7148) was enacted; its health care extenders division includes section 6225, which from 2028-01-01 conditions Medicare payment for off-campus hospital outpatient departments on a separate provider identifier and an attestation (section content per a think-tank summary).

CMS published the CY 2027 hospital outpatient and ambulatory surgical center proposed rule (91 FR 41734, CMS-1850-P, comments through 2026-08-31), which includes proposals to implement Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026 provisions for off-campus outpatient departments, including the section 6225 identifier and attestation requirement.

CMS published the CY 2027 physician fee schedule proposed rule (91 FR 43842, CMS-1848-P), which revises Medicare Shared Savings Program requirements and continues the program rather than repealing it (comments closed 2026-09-14).
